correctness.rationale: The explicit neighborhood formula out(C[U],(i,u))=out_U(u) in block i plus the full next block yields a cover by three contractible simplicial joins. Its geometric pair intersections are exactly three copies of N(U), with no geometric triple intersection. Cofibration homotopy-colimit replacement of contractible vertex spaces gives a cycle of suspension cylinders and hence S1 wedged with three reduced suspensions, including the disconnected-base case. Starting from the three isolated vertices of N(C3), induction gives 7*3^(k-2) top spheres and 3^(j-1) lower spheres. Regularity follows from m+(m-1)/2 outdegree. Two independent standard-library enumerators verify all specified finite cover identities and mod-2 ranks for orders 3, 9 and 15, and the reduced Euler characteristic at order 27; finite checks are explicitly bounded and not mistaken for the proof.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Similar tournament substitutions do not imply the theorem because the face predicates differ: a directed flag face is a transitive subtournament, while an out-neighborhood face has a common incoming witness. Prior homotopy classifications of one predicate do not determine the other. Moreover, the general iteration uses inner blocks not necessarily cyclic tournaments of the form considered in the prior flag-family theorem.

originality.rationale: The exact common-out-neighbor homotopy functor, the three-cone transfer for cyclic substitution, and the explicit iterated regular-tournament all-degree wedge formula are absent from the inspected primary accounts. The directly relevant online lexicographic construction classifies directed FLAG complexes with transitive-face criterion, not out-neighborhood complexes; its 9-vertex degree support differs. General directed-neighborhood suspension and existence theorems in the primary 2021 account have different inputs and/or weaker conclusions. Semantic record searches for exact formulas, aliases, equivalent Hom(directed-edge, -) constructions and the 27-vertex Betti case found no dominating result. This is a qualified originality judgment, not proof of worldwide uniqueness.
residual_risks: Unindexed or differently named homotopy-pushout theorem for a cyclic tournament substitution may reproduce the transfer lemma or its power-of-three specialization.
Sources outside the searchable corpus or not inspected in full may contain an equivalent calculation, so priority is not certified.

value.rationale: This gives a natural, unbounded regular-tournament sequence of sizes 3^k whose integral neighborhood homology is nonzero in EVERY degree 1 through k-1, unlike the prior individual-sphere existence constructions. The exact geometric three-cone lemma propagates homotopy types (and any suspension-shifted torsion) under an explicit tournament operation; the family classification includes all integral homotopy, fundamental group, and Betti ranks. This is a structural infinite-family result with a clear topological interpretation and is not a mere small-case enumeration or routine parameter increment.
